faqs.question: I am not technical. Can I still do this?
faqs.answer: Yes. I wrote every step so you can follow along even if you have never done anything like this. Layers 1 to 3 need no code at all. The one advanced setup in Layer 4 is optional, so you can leave it for later.

faqs.question: I have tried AI tools before and got overwhelmed. Will this be different?
faqs.answer: That is exactly who I made it for. I tell you what to do first: one pain, one setup, one week. You are not meant to do all 36 at once.

faqs.question: What does founding member mean?
faqs.answer: You are joining while the community is small, so you get first-hand help from me. The price goes up later, and the community will become a paid membership. As a founding member, you never pay a monthly fee. Free for life.

faqs.question: I do not have time. How long does each setup take?
faqs.answer: Most setups take 10 to 30 minutes. Do one tonight and you will see for yourself what you get back.

faqs.question: What if I get stuck?
faqs.answer: You are not on your own. Bring your screen to the weekend live class and we fix it together, or ask in the private community. I am in there with you.

faqs.question: What if I cannot connect my tools?
faqs.answer: Email me within 30 days with a short screen recording of the steps you followed. If I cannot give you the solution, I give you your money back, no questions asked, and send you ₦5,000 extra for wasting your time.

faqs.question: Do I need to pay for any tools?
faqs.answer: Some setups do. Each setup page tells you what it needs before you start, and I put the free options first wherever they exist.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the AutoStack Blueprint?
faqs.answer: No. The Starter Kit teaches you to set things up yourself with AI and no-code tools, and you do not need n8n. The Blueprint is a separate product of n8n engine automations for people who want more control.

faqs.question: Will it work for my business in Nigeria?
faqs.answer: The examples use naira and bank alerts. A few tools are not available in every country, and the setup page tells you when that matters.

faqs.question: What if a tool changes its menus?
faqs.answer: They do, often. When it happens I update the setup page and log the change on the New This Week page. You can also ask in the community.

faqs.question: How do I get the kit?
faqs.answer: After you pay, you get a link to the kit and an invite to the community. Open it on your phone or your laptop.

faqs.question: Can I share the kit with a friend?
faqs.answer: The kit is for the person who bought it. But you can share your partner link, and when someone joins through it, you earn a 30% partner share.
